about: Every visual stage of the characters, oldest first: milestones, review rounds and fixes. scripts/timeline.mjs (track "characters") turns this into timeline.gif. Add a stage with every visual commit; never overwrite a stage's picture. A commit cannot name itself, so the newest stage says "next" until the following commit fills in its hash.
